description: 100 distinct: distinct fruit or vegetable names

messages.content: List exactly 100 distinct fruit or vegetable names. Format each line as '<N>. <item>' with N running from 1 to 100 in strictly increasing order, one item per line. All 100 items must be distinct (case-insensitive) -- do not repeat any item. Output only the 100 numbered lines: no title, no intro, no closing remarks, no blank lines.
